description: #531 parity: mixed cross-derivative Dxy(u) on periodic 2D square domain. Analytic field u=sin(x)*sin(y); exact Dxy(u)=cos(x)*cos(y). Tests 4-point stencil (u[i+1,j+1]-u[i+1,j-1]-u[i-1,j+1]+u[i-1,j-1])/(4*dx*dy).

tolerance.notes: 4-point stencil coefficients are simple rationals ±1/(4*dx*dy); should be bit-identical across bindings to this tolerance.

fixtures.name: mixed_deriv_2d_periodic
fixtures.notes: 16x16 uniform grid on [0,2*pi]x[0,2*pi] (dx=dy=2*pi/16) with periodic BCs. u(x,y)=sin(x)*sin(y) at cell centers; exact Dxy(u)=cos(x)*cos(y).
